component.name: Shot
component.summary: Screenshot with inline annotation on GNOME

description.p: Shot captures the screen through the XDG desktop portal and opens a single frozen-view window: drag to select a region, annotate it with arrows, boxes, freehand strokes, text or a mosaic brush, then press Enter to copy the result and save it.
Screenshots are saved per application: Pictures/截图/<app>/.

ul.li: Single-window flow, no dialogs, no second editor
Arrows, rectangles, freehand, text and mosaic
Copy and save in one keystroke
